page.overview:
Who is Lola?

Lola is a woman Grunt met at [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georgia_Tech Georgia Tech]. She had served four years in the U.S. army as a helicopter mechanic for the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cavalry_tactics#Cavalry_in_modern_warfare air cavalry]. Her service paid for her college education.

Grunt and Lola also were part of the group Roadblock assembled against General Malthus' witch-hunt towards the G.I. Joe team.

Grunt and Lola got married at some point before the reinstatement of the G.I. Joe team. They had a daughter and, despite some complications during labor, both Lola and the baby survived.
